items.body: Exclusive: Almost two-thirds of visits lead to no arrests and nearly three-quarters are conducted without a warrant Shabana Mahmood’s ICE-style raid agency has been accused of engaging in “fishing expeditions” after figures disclosed that almost two-thirds of enforcement visits result in no arrests and nearly three-quarters are conducted without a warrant. The home secretary has hailed the expanded use of immigration enforcement teams, and claimed they will help to secure the UK’s borders by removing a key incentive for irregular migration. There were 23,538 immigration enforcement engagements such as workplace raids, home raids and spot checks in 2025 – or 60 a day. Of these, 15,578, or 66.1%, resulted in no arrests. Only 25.81% of visits where a premises was accessed used a warrant. Critics say this suggests the Home Office is launching “fishing expeditions” based on weak intelligence. Nearly nine out of 10 (89%) of leads alleging “immigration crime” in 2025 came from the public or from Crimestoppers, a charity that collects anonymous tip-offs. Around 2% came from the police. items.body: Annette Young is pleased to welcome Renaud Foucart, Senior Lecturer at the Department of Economics ECARES at Lancaster University. France's 1.6% minimum-wage increase, in response to the countrywide protests, may offer a temporary reprieve from social unrest, but it does little to resolve the deeper political and institutional crisis confronting the country. According to Foucart, the central problem extends beyond declining purchasing power, fiscal constraints and the limitations of a minority government. It concerns a growing loss of faith in politics itself. “They are in the street because they don't believe politics can achieve anything,” Foucart argues, suggesting that the persistence of mass demonstrations ahead of the presidential election reflects profound disillusionment with the political system's capacity to deliver meaningful change.

items.summary: Black women and girls represent an outsized share of LA homicide victims – frustrated with police and legislators’ failures, they’re stepping up and speaking out to stop the violence As a child, Tioni Theus was a ball of energy. After school she liked to play golf and dance. On w
items.body: Black women and girls represent an outsized share of LA homicide victims – frustrated with police and legislators’ failures, they’re stepping up and speaking out to stop the violence As a child, Tioni Theus was a ball of energy. After school she liked to play golf and dance. On weekends, she’d go to the movies and the mall with her older cousin. Driving back home at the end of the day to her family’s apartment in South Los Angeles, California, she’d ask: “What are we doing next?” Everything changed when Tioni was 13. Her mother was hit by a car and critically injured, leaving her unable to take care of her daughter. While her mom recovered, Tioni lived with other family members. But the accident left Tioni angry, her older cousin Nafeesah Kincy said, and she struggled to understand that her life had permanently changed. Continue reading...

ကချင်ပြည်နယ်ရဲ့ တံခါးပေါက်ဖြစ်တဲ့ စစ်ကိုင်းတိုင်း၊ အင်းတော်မြို့နယ်၊ မော်လူးမြို့အနီးက အာဏာသိမ်း စစ်တပ်ရဲ့ ယာယီခြေကုပ်စခန်း ၃ ခုကို ကချင်လွတ်မြောက်ရေးတပ်မတော် (KIA) ဦးဆောင်တဲ့ တော်လှန်ရေး ပူးပေါင်းတပ်တွေက တိုက်ခိုက်သိမ်းပိုက်လိုက်တယ်လို့ မြေပြင်စစ်ရေး သတင်းရင်းမြစ် တွေက ဧရာဝတီကိုပြောပါတယ်။

အဲဒီစခန်းတွေဟာ မော်လူးနဲ့ အင်းတော်မြို့ကြားက စီပိန်း၊ ဖားပန့်နဲ့ ပင်ဝယ်ကျေးရွာတွေမှာ အခြေစိုက်ထားတာဖြစ်ပြီး ပြီးခဲ့တဲ့ နိုဝင်ဘာလ ၇ ရက်နေ့က KIA၊ အာရက္ခတပ်တော် (AA)၊ မြန်မာနိုင်ငံလုံးဆိုင်ရာ ကျောင်းသားများ ဒီမိုကရက်တစ်တပ်ဦး (ABSDF) နဲ့ ပြည်သူ့ကာကွယ်ရေး တပ်မတော် (PDF) တို့က အပြီးသတ် တိုက်ခိုက်သိမ်းပိုက်ခဲ့တာလို့ သိရပါတယ်။
